english.note: Use this for milder reluctance when the person does not really want to do something but may still do it.

examples.english: It's raining so heavily today, so I'm reluctant to go out.
examples.traditional: 今日落咁大雨，我唔係好想出街。
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1
